summary: Verified the OTP Bird-rejection bug fix end-to-end against the external Convex backend (fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site) and the Expo web preview login screen. All 7 pytest cases pass (OTP validation, Syria WhatsApp-fallback failure, verify guard, seeded bearer tokens including OWNER/DEVELOPER + 401 cases). Frontend login flow correctly surfaces the precise Arabic error 'خدمة واتساب غير مهيأة للإرسال في حساب Bird (تسعير/رصيد واتساب غير متوفر). فعّل تسعير واتساب أو أضف رصيداً في حساب Bird.' containing both 'واتساب' and 'Bird', and does NOT silently advance to the code-entry step for +963984644375. No deprecated Expo packages or React Native issues found in the login screen; all interactive elements expose testIDs.
critical_code_review_comments: src/auth.tsx requestOtp swallows the thrown error inside run() and resolves to null — this is actually the intended behavior that surfaces the error via the error state, but the parseable 'sent' flag relying on closure assignment (let sent) is slightly fragile; consider returning the channel directly from run().
src/api.ts path parameter is interpolated directly into the URL; it does not strip leading slashes or validate — fine for current callers but worth guarding.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded bearer tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test_token_owner, test_token_dev).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is EXTERNAL Convex at https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api — do not hit local FastAPI stub. OTP request for a Syria number polls Bird for ~8s before returning 400, so give the frontend send button up to 20–25s to show the login-error. Seeded bearer tokens are the only reliable way to reach authenticated screens; inject via localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('test_token_owner')) before navigation.
